rationale: This revised plan addresses all three failed checks from the prior evaluation. First, synthetic_caveats is now included as a required section in brief_sections to transparently document that the analysis is based on synthetic data and that observed patterns do not represent real-world claims characteristics. Second, causal_language is set to 'avoid' to prevent generation of forbidden causal phrasing (causes, drives, leads to, because of) and reinforce statistical discipline; the parameter setting prevents generation rather than requiring post-hoc editing. Third, the synthetic_data caveat in write_report documents data limitations, and no_operational_use caveat clarifies that model scores are analytical-only and require governance review before operational deployment. Together, these changes establish clear foundational safeguards that protect stakeholder interpretation of findings from a descriptive analysis of synthetic data.
changes_summary: Two parameter changes address the failed checks: (1) Added 'synthetic_caveats' to brief_sections.sections to include the missing required section that transparently documents synthetic data limitations; changed from [key_findings, model_results, limitations, next_steps] to [key_findings, model_results, limitations, synthetic_caveats, next_steps]. (2) Changed brief_sections.causal_language from 'allow' to 'avoid' to prevent generation of causal phrasing; this parameter setting is foundational and prevents forbidden phrases such as 'drives' from being generated during brief composition, eliminating the need for post-hoc editing and reinforcing statistical discipline.
